name: Push and Slide!
desc:
🎉 Welcome to Push and Slide!

Get ready for an exciting challenge where you become Sisyphus, sliding at high speed while you dodge tricky obstacles and collect rewards.

Push to the top and slide 👑

🧗 Push the rock
💰 Collect coins
🐦 Unlock mythical partners
🌍 Unlock the map

📢NEW CODE: CHILL

👍 Join our group and like the game for more updates!
